about.en: Cellframe Network is an open-source, service-oriented blockchain platform developed by Demlabs, built around sharding and post-quantum cryptography, on which projects can build their own chains and services. CELL is its native token, used for fees, staking and governance on the Cellframe Backbone and bridged as an ERC-20 on Ethereum (0x26c8AFBBFE1EBaca03C2bB082E69D0476Bffe099) and a BEP-20 on BNB Chain (0xd98438889Ae7364c7E2A3540547Fad042FB24642); both deployments are the same project's token.
